grade: Crianças pequenas (4 anos a 5 anos e 11 meses)
subject: Espaços, Tempos, Quantidades, Relações e Transformações
description_pt: Expressar medidas (peso, altura etc.), construindo gráficos básicos.

components.description_pt: Registrar medidas como peso e altura de forma organizada
components.description_en: Record measurements such as weight and height in an organized manner

components.description_pt: Construir gráficos simples para representar dados de medidas pessoais
components.description_en: Construct basic graphs to represent personal measurement data
components.cc_component_description: Create a line plot where the horizontal scale is marked off in whole-number units to display measurement data

components.description_pt: Interpretar gráficos simples construídos a partir de dados de medidas
components.description_en: Interpret simple graphs built from measurement data
components.cc_component_description: Interpret data with up to three categories

cc_matches.description: Generate measurement data by measuring lengths of several objects to the nearest whole unit, or by making repeated measurements of the same object. Show the measurements by making a line plot, where the horizontal scale is marked off in whole-number units.

Organize, represent, and interpret data with up to three categories; ask and answer questions about the total number of data points, how many in each category, and how many more or less are in one category than in another.
